        k = parts[0]
        coords = tuple(parts[1:])
        vectors.append(coords)
    
    basis = []
    rank = 0
    
    for vec in vectors:
        if len(vec) == 1:
            coord = vec[0] - 1

                if basis[i][coord]:
                    found = True
                    new_vec = tuple((basis[i][j] + vec[0] - 1) % 2 for j in range(m))
                    vec = new_vec
            if not found:
                basis.append([0] * m)
                basis[rank][coord] = 1
                rank += 1
        else:
            coord1, coord2 = vec[0] - 1, vec[1] - 1
            found = False
            for i in range(len(basis)):
                if basis[i][coord1] and basis[i][coord2]:
                    found = True
                    new_vec = tuple((basis[i][k] + vec[k] - 1) % 2 for k in range(m))
                    vec = new_vec
            if not found:
                
                basis.append([0] * m)
                basis[rank][coord1] = 1
                basis[rank][coord2] = 1
                rank += 1
    
    size_T = 2 ** rank

    for i in range(n):
